chunks: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“The hadd is not carried out upon the woman in istihadah until the blood ceases from her.”

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing irregular vaginal bleeding (istihadah)

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment carried out on a woman in istihadah before her bleeding stops?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the prescribed hadd punishment is not implemented on a woman experiencing istihadah until her bleeding stops. It reflects consideration of her physical condition within the application of judicial rulings.
